summary: This sermon teaches that prayer is sincere communion with God requiring regular discipline. The pastor guides the congregation through four types of prayer—gratitude, lament, petition, and intercession—and challenges everyone to schedule recurring prayer appointments to develop an honest, intimate relationship with God that transforms duty into delight.
key_points: Schedule regular prayer times as a disciplined practice
Gratitude recognizes God's goodness and generosity toward us
Lament brings our pain and suffering honestly before God
Petition asks God to fulfill his promises in our lives
Intercession prays for others, joining God's work in their lives
Naked sincerity and humility are essential for authentic prayer
big_idea: Prayer is our sincere, honest communion with God that transforms us through gratitude, lament, petition, and intercession, requiring regular discipline to move from duty to delight.
title: PRAYER: Talking With God
